<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY ent_inner 'Expanded Text'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?target-pi data="processing instruction content with &ent_inner;"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Comment containing an entity reference &ent_inner; -->
  <child ns2:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags> and entity references &ent_inner;
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&ent_inner;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:custom="http://xml.org/custom">
  <!-- Top-level comment testing parser resilience -->
  <section custom:attr="value">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with markup: <section> &e2; </section>
    ]]>
    &e2;
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY root_ent "Catalog Root">
  <!ENTITY ref_ent "&root_ent; - Subitem">
  <!ENTITY % ext_param SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext_param;
]>
<?catalog-control mode="strict" verbose="yes"?>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment before elements containing entities and CDATA -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <item>Raw text with entity &ref_ent;</item>
    ]]>
    &ref_ent;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock_name "Widget">
  <!ENTITY stock_desc "A very useful &stock_name;">
  <!ENTITY % p_entity "<!ENTITY p_resolved 'Resolved Parameter'>">
  %p_entity;
]>
<?inventory-log date="2023-10-01" status="active"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:v="http://inventory.org/v">
  <!-- Comment explaining the inventory items -->
  <stock v:score="99">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block: description is &stock_desc; and parameter is &p_resolved;
    ]]>
    &stock_desc;
  </stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base_rec "Record Base">
  <!ENTITY full_rec "&base_rec; Extended">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc_ref "Document" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % p_dec "<!ATTLIST record code ID #IMPLIED>">
  %p_dec;
]>
<?archive-meta author="admin" version="2.0"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment verifying CDATA, PI, DTD, ENTITY, and xmlns interplay -->
  <record code="R001" meta:category="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive entry data: &full_rec; inside CDATA section.
    ]]>
    &full_rec;
  </record>
</archive>
```
